info.title: Cortana AI Public API
info.description: The Cortana AI Public API enables programmatic access to contacts, conversations, messages, agents, appointments and calendars, pipelines and deals, custom metrics, the history of who changed what, conversions, tracking sessions, tags, custom fields, financial data (Stripe, Shopify, Whop), attribution analytics, voice call logs/transcripts, meeting data, and agency-level business creation. Most endpoints are scoped to a business (`/api/v1/businesses/{businessId}/...`); creating a new business uses `POST /api/v1/businesses`, and **agency business templates** (same as *Copy as template* in the app) are listed with `GET /api/v1/businesses/templates` for use as `templateId` on create. All endpoints require Bearer token authentication.

post.description:
Creates a new business under the API key owner's agency (same as adding a business in the Control Centre), including defaults or an optional agency template.

**Authentication:** Bearer API key with the **`businesses:write`** scope. This scope is not included in the default *Chrome Extension* preset — use *Agency / onboarding automation* or add **Businesses → Write** when generating the key.

**Who may call:** The key must belong to an **agency owner**, **superuser**, or **manager with Admin** access. Non-superusers need an **active plan**.

**Templates:** To copy configuration from an agency template created in the UI (*Copy as template*), call **`GET /api/v1/businesses/templates`**, pick an `id`, and pass it as **`templateId`** in this request body.

**After success:** Use the returned `id` as `{businessId}` on routes such as `GET /api/v1/businesses/{businessId}/contacts`.

403.description: Insufficient scope, wrong role, inactive plan, or cannot resolve agency

get.description:
Returns agency **business templates** (the same assets you save with *Copy as template* in the Control Centre). Use a template **`id`** as **`templateId`** on `POST /api/v1/businesses`.

**Privacy:** Pass **`omitSource=true`** to omit `sourceBusinessId` and `sourceBusinessName` when you do not want API consumers to see which client business a template was copied from.

**Authentication:** Bearer API key with the **`businesses:write`** scope (same as create business).

**Who may call:** Same rules as create business — **agency owner**, **superuser**, or **manager with Admin**; non-superusers need an **active plan**.

parameters.name: omitSource
parameters.description: When `true` (or `1` / `yes`), each item omits `sourceBusinessId` and `sourceBusinessName` so the response does not reveal the originating client business.

200.description: Templates for the API key owner's agency

403.description: Insufficient scope, wrong role, inactive plan, or cannot resolve agency

patch.description:
Changes a business's company profile, the details under **Settings → Business Info**: name, owner, industry, website, contact email, phone, address and service area. Only the fields you send change. Send `null` or `""` to clear an optional field; `name` and `industry` cannot be cleared.

**Authentication:** Bearer API key with the **`businesses:write`** scope (**Businesses → Write** when generating the key). A key limited to chosen businesses can update only those.

**Who may call:** the key's owner needs access to the business and the **Manage general settings** permission, the same rule as saving Business Info in the app. Agency owners always have it.

**Timezone:** not editable here. A timezone change re-buckets every report, so it is changed in the app under Settings → Business Info. A body with `timezone` is refused with 400.

**Response:** the business info after the change, and `changes`: each changed field with its value before and after. A body that changes nothing returns `changes: []` and writes nothing.

200.description: Business info updated (or already held these values)

403.description: Missing the businesses:write scope, or the key's owner lacks access or the Manage general settings permission on this business

get.description:
The business's appointments, a page at a time.

**Authentication:** the `appointments:read` scope.

**Paging:** numbered pages (`page`) answer `total`, `page`, `limit` and `hasMore`, and also `nextCursor`. Pass `cursor` instead of `page` to page by cursor: a booking made while you page never shifts a page, so a sync never repeats or skips one. A cursor answer carries `limit`, `hasMore` and `nextCursor` only. Send the same `sort` with a cursor as the page it came from, or the request is refused with 400.

**Statuses:** `SHOWED` and `NO_SHOW` are the outcomes a rep marks, filterable like the others.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any 1 to 255 visible characters (a UUID works), one per new record. Send the same key again when you retry the same request: the record the first request made is answered with 200 and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, never a second one. Keys belong to your API key.

200.description: A retry: the booking this `Idempotency-Key` already made

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present when this answer is the record an earlier request already made, nothing new was written

202.description: Booked in the calendar's own system (GoHighLevel, Calendly or iClosed). Cortana's copy arrives with its next sync. A retry before then answers the same, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present when this answer is the record an earlier request already made, nothing new was written

example.message: Booked in the calendar's own system. Cortana's copy arrives with its next sync.

409.description: The time cannot be booked, or the key holds another booking

error.message: This Idempotency-Key already holds a booking for another contact, calendar or time. Send a new key for a new booking.

502.description: GoHighLevel, Calendly or iClosed refused the booking or did not answer

error.message: The booking could not be made.

post.description:
Books an appointment. Two kinds of body:

- **Into a calendar** (the body names `eventTypeId`): the same booking as the booking page and the app's **Book** button. The calendar's hours, notice and seats hold, a rep is picked, the time is locked, the lead gets the confirmation, and Google, Outlook and the CRM follow. The appointment's history names your key: "Booked for Wed, Nov 25, 4:30 PM · Acme Scheduler, via API".
- **With no calendar:** the appointment is stored as you send it. It holds no time on a calendar and sends no emails.

**Authentication:** the `appointments:write` scope.

**Retries:** send an `Idempotency-Key`. A retry with the same key answers the first booking with 200 and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, also on a calendar that books into GoHighLevel, Calendly or iClosed. The same key with another contact, calendar or time is refused with 409, and the first booking stands.

**Calendars that book elsewhere:** a calendar that books into GoHighLevel, Calendly or iClosed is booked there first. When Cortana's copy is not there yet, the answer is 202 with `data: null` and a message: the copy arrives with that system's next sync. A retry of such a booking before its copy arrives answers 202 again, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and "Already booked in the calendar's own system. Cortana's copy arrives with its next sync."

**Refusals:**
- 400: a time in the past ("Cannot book a slot in the past. Pick another time.") or inside the calendar's minimum notice ("Appointments must be booked at least 60 minutes in advance. Pick another time.", with that calendar's notice); a field the calendar decides; `scheduledAt` not a whole minute in `timezone`; a time zone that is not an IANA name; a meeting link that is not http(s); a contact of another business on a calendar-less booking ("Contact not found in this business"); a bad `Idempotency-Key`.
- 404: "Calendar not found" (another business's, or switched off), "Contact not found for this business".
- 409: the time cannot be taken: "That time is no longer open on this calendar. Pick another time.", "That time was just taken. Pick another time.", "There is already a booking at exactly this time. Pick another time.", "This day is fully booked. Pick another day.", "No rep on this calendar is free at that time. Pick a rep, or another time.", or GoHighLevel's, Calendly's or iClosed's own words for a taken time; "This Idempotency-Key already holds a booking for another contact, calendar or time. Send a new key for a new booking."; "A booking with this key is still being made. Try again in a few seconds."; "This calendar lost its link to the system it syncs from. Reconnect it in Cortana before booking."; "This Calendly account only takes bookings on Calendly's own page. Book this one in Calendly."
- 502 `UPSTREAM_ERROR`: GoHighLevel, Calendly or iClosed refused the booking or did not answer.

get.description:
One appointment of the business.

**Authentication:** the `appointments:read` scope.

409.description: The time is taken, the appointment changed while this saved, it is cancelled and no new time was sent, or it lives in Calendly or iClosed

error.message: This appointment changed a moment ago. Refresh it and try again.

patch.description:
Changes an appointment through the same edit as the app's calendar: a new time moves its lock and its reminders, a cancel frees the time, the lead's emails go, and Google, Outlook and GoHighLevel are told. Its history names your key.

**A booking that lives in Calendly or iClosed:** a new `scheduledAt`, or `status: CANCELLED`, is refused with 409 and nothing is written. Move or cancel it in Calendly or iClosed, and Cortana's copy follows at that system's next sync. Its other fields and its outcomes (`SHOWED`, `NO_SHOW`, `COMPLETED`) still change here.

**A cancelled appointment:** send a new `scheduledAt` to reopen it. It becomes `RESCHEDULED` at that time, the time is held, the lead gets the rescheduled email and reminders, and GoHighLevel is told. A status alone, whichever it is (`BOOKED`, `RESCHEDULED`, `SHOWED`, `NO_SHOW` or `COMPLETED`, with no new `scheduledAt`), would change nothing else, so it is refused with 409 and nothing is written: send a time, or book it again with `POST /appointments`. The time the appointment already has counts as no new time. If the appointment is cancelled while a status-only request runs, it is refused with 409 "This appointment changed a moment ago. Refresh it and try again."

**Authentication:** the `appointments:write` scope.

**Refusals:**
- 404: "Appointment not found" (another business's, or gone).
- 409: "That appointment is cancelled. Send a new scheduledAt to reopen it at a time, or book it again."
- 409: "This booking lives in Calendly. Move it there and Cortana follows." for a new time, "This booking lives in Calendly. Cancel it there and Cortana follows." for a cancel ("iClosed" for a booking that lives there).
- 409: "That time is already booked for this rep. Pick another slot.", "That time is already booked on this calendar. Pick another slot.", "This appointment changed a moment ago. Refresh it and try again." (someone changed it while yours was saving), "Another change to this booking was saving at the same moment. Try again."

409.description: Someone changed it at the same moment, or it lives in Calendly or iClosed

error.message: This appointment changed a moment ago. Refresh it and try again.

delete.description:
Cancels the appointment, as **Cancel** in the app does: its status becomes `CANCELLED`, the time opens again, the lead gets the calendar's cancel email, and Google, Outlook and GoHighLevel are told. Nothing is deleted: the answer is the cancelled appointment, with 200. Asking again for one already cancelled answers it, with 200.

A booking that lives in Calendly or iClosed is not cancelled here: it is refused with 409 and nothing changes. Cancel it in Calendly or iClosed, and Cortana's copy follows at that system's next sync.

**Authentication:** the `appointments:write` scope.

**Refusals:** 404 "Appointment not found"; 409 "This booking lives in Calendly. Cancel it there and Cortana follows." ("iClosed" for a booking that lives there); 409 "This appointment changed a moment ago. Refresh it and try again." when someone changed it at the same moment.

When the conversion holds entries the call answers 409 with the count until you re-send it with confirmEntryCount equal to that count. Refund conversions managed by the system answer 403; they are removed with the conversion they belong to.

get.description:
The business's calendars, the ones a booking can go into: up to 500, switched-on first, then by name. `truncated` is true when the business has more.

`id` is what `POST /appointments` takes as `eventTypeId`. `provider` is `CORTANA`, or the system the calendar books into (`GHL`, `CALENDLY`, `ICLOSED`), which then picks the rep and the open times: such a calendar lists no team.

**Authentication:** the `appointments:read` scope.

post.description:
Makes a new booking calendar, as **New calendar** in the app does. Only `name` is required; every other setting starts at the app's default, as `GET` shows it.

It takes the next free link made from `slug`, or from its name (`intro-call`, then `intro-call-2`), opens Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on the business's clock, sends the lead a booking confirmation and a reminder the day before, and gets its own booking page. Set its hours with `PUT …/hours` and its team with `PUT …/team`.

**Authentication:** the `appointments:write` scope.

**Retries:** there is no `Idempotency-Key` here. A create retried after a timeout can leave a second calendar: switch it off with `PATCH` and `isActive: false`.

**Refusals:**
- 400: a value out of range ("A meeting is 1 to 1,440 minutes (24 hours) long.", "The buffer before is 0 to 1,440 minutes (24 hours)."), or a field this body does not take.

get.description:
One calendar with everything a person sets on it: its settings, its weekly hours and dated exceptions, and its team.

A calendar that books into GoHighLevel, Calendly or iClosed names under `managedBy` what that system sets: its hours, its team and the `settings` listed. A change to those is refused with where to make it.

A team member's own meeting location is named by its type only.

**Authentication:** the `appointments:read` scope.

Changes a calendar's settings, as its editor in the app does. Send only what changes. A changed `slug` is cleaned the same way as on create.

`isActive: false` switches the calendar off: its booking page takes no new bookings, and the appointments already booked stay. `isActive: true` switches it back on. There is no DELETE (it answers 405): switching off is how a calendar is retired.

**Authentication:** the `appointments:write` scope.

**Refusals:**
- 400: a value out of range ("A meeting is 1 to 1,440 minutes (24 hours) long.", "The buffer before is 0 to 1,440 minutes (24 hours)."), a field this body does not take, or a setting the calendar's own system sets ("This calendar's length and scheduling rules come from GoHighLevel. Change them there.").
- 404: "Calendar not found" (another business's).
- 409: a link another calendar or a form of the business uses ("A calendar with this slug already exists", "A form already uses this link. Pick a different one."), or a link that is a published blog post on one of the business's domains.

get.description:
The calendar's open times, day by day: exactly the times a lead sees on its booking page, ready to book.

Up to 14 days a request; with no `to`, 7 days from `from`. Times read like `9:00 AM` on `timezone`'s clock. To book one, send that date and time as `scheduledAt` to `POST /appointments` with the same `timezone` and the calendar as `eventTypeId`.

A calendar that books into GoHighLevel, Calendly or iClosed is asked one day at a time. Once 20 seconds have passed, no new day is read and the answer carries `moreFrom`, the date to ask from next. A day marked `unavailable` is the last one read: that system did not answer (`ghl`, `calendly`, `iclosed`), or the rep cannot be booked on this calendar (`routed_rep`).

**Authentication:** the `appointments:read` scope.

**Refusals:** 400 "Send from with to.", "to must be on or after from.", "Ask for at most 14 days per request.", "That date does not exist. Use YYYY-MM-DD.", "That rep is not on this calendar's team.", or a rep named on a calendar whose own system picks the rep; 404 "Calendar not found" (another business's, or switched off).

Every pipeline with its stages in the board's order, which one is the default, and `syncedWith`: the CRMs a pipeline is kept in sync with (its new stages are added there). Also `lostReasons`, what a move to `lost` or `abandoned` takes.

A read never creates anything: a business with no pipeline answers `[]`, and the first deal added makes its Sales Pipeline.

**Authentication:** the `deals:read` scope.

post.description:
Adds a stage to a pipeline, last unless `position` says where. A pipeline holds at most 30 stages.

A stage of that name already in the pipeline (in any letter case) is answered as it is, with 200, and nothing is written: a `position` or `probability` you sent is not applied, and the answer shows the stage's real values. A new stage answers 201. So a retried add never makes a second stage.

**Authentication:** the `deals:write` scope.

**Refusals:**
- 409 a pipeline kept in sync with a CRM, whose stages are added there: "This pipeline is kept in sync with GoHighLevel, so its stages are set there. Turn sync off in CRM settings → Sync to add one here."
- 400 a pipeline already at 30 stages; 404 another business's pipeline.

patch.description:
Changes a stage's name, win probability, stale days or place in the order. Send only what changes.

Renaming and reordering work on a pipeline kept in sync with a CRM too. Nothing deletes a stage here.

**Authentication:** the `deals:write` scope.

**Refusals:** 404 another business's stage.

get.description:
The deals of one pipeline or one stage, a page at a time. Send `pipelineId` or `stageId`.

A pipeline's deals come in a stable order a sync can follow. A stage's come most recently changed first, as the board's column reads them: a deal changed while you page can move to the front.

**Paging:** cursor only, no total. A `status` or `ownerId` filter looks through part of a large pipeline at a time: a page can hold fewer deals than `limit` and still have `hasMore: true`. `scanned` says how many deals it looked through. Keep paging until `hasMore` is false. A cursor from another pipeline or stage is refused with 400.

**Authentication:** the `deals:read` scope.

Adds a deal for a contact, as **New deal** on the board does. It lands in the stage you name, else the first stage of the pipeline you name, else the first stage of the default pipeline (a business with no pipeline yet gets its Sales Pipeline). It is named after the contact unless you name it. A stage that tracks a conversion records it, and a pipeline synced with a CRM sends it there.

**Authentication:** the `deals:write` scope.

**Retries:** send an `Idempotency-Key`. A retry with the same key answers the deal the first request made, with 200 and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The same key with a different deal is refused with 409: "This Idempotency-Key already made a different deal (another contact, pipeline, stage, name, value, owner or source). Send a new key for a new deal."

**Refusals:**
- 400 "Stage is not in this pipeline" when you send both `pipelineId` and `stageId` and the stage is not that pipeline's (another business's included); "That user is not a member of this business"; a pipeline with no stages yet; a field this body does not take.
- 404 "Contact not found"; "Pipeline not found" or "Stage not found" when you send only one of them and it is not this business's.

Changes a deal as its card in the app does: its name, value and how it recurs, cash collected, owner, source and custom fields. Send only what changes. To move it, or mark it won or lost, use `POST /deals/{dealId}/move`.

**Changed since you read it:** pass `expectedUpdatedAt`, the `updatedAt` you read. If anything changed the deal since, the request is refused with 409 "This deal changed a moment ago. Reload it and try again." and nothing is written. A teammate adding a task moves `updatedAt` too. Without it, your save is checked only against a change landing at the same moment: a teammate's save of the same field an instant before refuses it the same way, and saves of different fields never refuse each other.

**Authentication:** the `deals:write` scope.

**Refusals:**
- 400 a custom field value its type cannot hold ("\"Budget\" needs a number."), a custom field value over 5,000 characters, "That user is not a member of this business", a field this body does not take.
- 409 "This deal changed a moment ago. Reload it and try again."; on a deal synced with a CRM that carries owners, an owner that CRM cannot take, or an unassign ("This deal is synced with your CRM. Unassign it there for now; reassigning here works.").
- 404 "Deal not found", or a `fieldId` that is not one of the business's fields.

Custom fields are saved first. If the rest is then refused, the message starts "The custom fields were saved; the rest was not."

Moves a deal to another stage of its pipeline, marks it `won`, `lost` or `abandoned`, or reopens it (`open`), as the board and the deal card do. Its CRM is told, and a stage or a win that tracks a conversion records it. A move and a status at once is one change.

`moved: false` means the deal already sat there: nothing was written.

**Moved since you read it:** pass `fromStageId`, `fromStatus` or both: what you saw. If someone moved it since, the request is refused with 409 and nothing is written.

**Authentication:** the `deals:write` scope.

**Refusals:**
- 400 "Target stage is not in this pipeline", a `lostReason` label that is not one of the business's, a lost reason with a status other than `lost` or `abandoned`.
- 409 "This deal was just moved by someone else — refresh and try again", "That stage was just deleted — refresh".
- 404 "Deal not found"; "Lost reason not found" for a `lostReasonId` that is not one of the business's.

Makes a custom metric, as the metric builder in Ad Tracking does. It shows as a column in the table.

**Formulas** are written with the pieces the metric builder in Ad Tracking offers, in braces: the standard metrics (`{ad-spend}`, `{total-revenue}`, `{unique-visitors}`, `{days}`, …), each of the business's conversions (its count, cost per and revenue, such as `{conversion-<id>-count}`), and another custom metric as `{custom:<id>}`, with `+ - * /` and parentheses. A `percent` formula is a share (leads / visitors), shown ×100. Check one with `POST /custom-metrics/validate` before you save it.

**Retries:** the same name, formula and format again answers the metric already there, with 200, `existing: true` and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, never a second one. A name already used with another formula or format is refused with 409: change that metric instead.

`warnings` lists what the builder would warn about (a division that can be zero, a conversion that is off).

A metric another live metric uses cannot be turned off until that one changes or is off. One whose formula uses a metric that is off cannot come back on until that one does.

Who changed what, and from where, across the business: the last 30 days, newest first. Each line reads as the record's History panel in the app reads it, and names its `record` (read that record's own history with `GET /history/{kind}/{recordId}`). `kinds` says which kinds of record your key may read, `window.since` where the 30 days start.

Narrow it with `kind` (one kind of record) or `actorKind` (one kind of actor: `ai` is what Claude, ChatGPT or another AI changed; `api_key` a builder's app; `crm_sync` a CRM's sync).

**Authentication:** any one of `appointments:read`, `deals:read`, `metrics:read`, `conversions:read`. The feed answers the kinds your scopes cover: appointments and calendars with `appointments:read`, deals and pipelines with `deals:read`, custom metrics with `metrics:read`, conversions with `conversions:read`. Custom metrics and conversions also need the key owner's Ad Tracking **View** permission; without it they are left out.

**Notes:**
- A page can hold fewer lines than `limit`, even none, and still have `hasMore: true`. Keep paging until it is false.
- A conversion's value, attribution and time edits are kept on the conversion itself: read them with `GET /history/conversion/{recordId}`. `kind=conversion` here answers only changes recorded as history lines on conversions, and is empty today.

**Refusals:** 400 a cursor this API did not make, an unknown parameter; 403 a `kind` your scopes do not cover ("Insufficient scope. Required: deals:read"), or nothing left to read.

- A deal a CRM sync or an import made ends on a line such as "Created · GoHighLevel sync".

A custom metric or a conversion also needs the key owner's Ad Tracking **View** permission.
